title: I'm building a dark fantasy extraction RPG where 4 strangers enter a cursed castle
author: zanemoore575
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I'm a solo dev from New Zealand working on Nightfall, a third-person dark fantasy extraction RPG.

The idea is to combine the class identity, quests and progression of traditional RPGs with the danger and unpredictability of extraction games.

Four players enter Dawnhold Castle, exploring its ruins, fighting undead, completing quests and discovering equipment. Other players might be lurking somewhere in the castle too.

Death means losing everything you're carrying, but extracting safely lets you keep what you've found.

It's still very early in development, and I'm working towards the first multiplayer alpha playtest.

I've used AI assistance for coding and some UI artwork, alongside purchased 3D asset packs and adapted animations.

I'm particularly interested in whether the core gameplay concept sounds like something you'd want to play. Would you enjoy a slower-paced, quest-driven extraction RPG?

comments.author: klabelkholosh
comments.body: This absolutely sounds like something I'd want to play, very cool idea 🙌 please keep us updated!
